name: Google BigQuery
description: Connect your own Google BigQuery project to manage datasets, tables, queries/jobs, and scheduled queries, and audit warehouse cost and health -- from Imperal. Uses your own GCP Service Account -- nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself.

tools.name: connect_bigquery
tools.description: Connect your own Google Cloud project by pasting a Service Account JSON key, after checking it actually works against BigQuery.

service_account_json.description: Paste the full contents of your GCP Service Account JSON key file.
service_account_json.title: Service Account Json

label.description: Optional friendly name for this connection.
label.title: Label

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Google Cloud projects (BigQuery).

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: disconnect_bigquery
tools.description: Disconnect a Google Cloud project: deletes the saved Service Account key. Nothing in BigQuery itself is changed.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List BigQuery datasets in the connected project, with location and default table expiration.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Read one BigQuery dataset in full by its id.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_dataset
tools.description: Create a new BigQuery dataset in the connected project.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

default_table_expiration_days.description: Optional default table expiration in days (0 = never expire).
default_table_expiration_days.title: Default Table Expiration Days

tools.name: delete_dataset
tools.description: Permanently delete a BigQuery dataset. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

delete_contents.description: If true, deletes all tables inside the dataset too. Cannot be undone.
delete_contents.title: Delete Contents

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List tables inside one BigQuery dataset.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

dataset_id.description: Dataset id to list tables from.
dataset_id.title: Dataset Id

tools.name: get_table
tools.description: Read one BigQuery table in full -- schema, row count, size, and partitioning.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: delete_table
tools.description: Permanently delete a BigQuery table. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

table_id.description: Table id to delete. Cannot be undone.
table_id.title: Table Id

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Run a SQL query against BigQuery. Always dry-runs first to estimate bytes billed, then executes and returns result rows.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

query.description: Standard SQL query to run, e.g. 'SELECT * FROM `project.dataset.table` LIMIT 100'.
query.title: Query

dry_run.description: If true, only estimates bytes that would be processed/billed without running the query.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read one BigQuery job in full by its id -- status, timing, and any error info.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

job_id.description: Job id from execute_query or list_jobs.
job_id.title: Job Id

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List recent BigQuery jobs (query runs) in the connected project, most recent first.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_scheduled_queries
tools.description: List scheduled queries (recurring BigQuery jobs via Data Transfer Service) configured for a location in the connected project.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

location.description: Region the scheduled queries live in, e.g. 'us', 'eu'.
location.title: Location

tools.name: create_scheduled_query
tools.description: Create a new scheduled query (recurring BigQuery job) via Data Transfer Service.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

location.description: Region to create the scheduled query in, e.g. 'us', 'eu'.
location.title: Location

display_name.description: Name shown for this scheduled query.
display_name.title: Display Name

query.description: SQL query to run on schedule.
query.title: Query

schedule.description: Schedule in BigQuery Data Transfer syntax, e.g. 'every 24 hours', 'every mon 09:00'.
schedule.title: Schedule

destination_dataset_id.description: Optional dataset id to write results into as a new table.
destination_dataset_id.title: Destination Dataset Id

tools.name: delete_scheduled_query
tools.description: Permanently delete a scheduled query. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

transfer_config_name.description: Full transfer config resource name from list_scheduled_queries.
transfer_config_name.title: Transfer Config Name

tools.name: run_scheduled_query
tools.description: Manually trigger a scheduled query to run right now, regardless of its schedule.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

transfer_config_name.description: Full transfer config resource name from list_scheduled_queries.
transfer_config_name.title: Transfer Config Name

tools.name: audit_project
tools.description: Build one aggregated health report across the connected BigQuery project: datasets with no default table expiration, non-partitioned large tables, and recent failed jobs.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected project.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: bigquery_connections
secrets.description: Your connected Google Cloud projects -- stored as a JSON array, one entry per project, each with its own Service Account credentials (project_id, client_email, private_key). Managed through connect_bigquery / disconnect_bigquery -- you should not need to edit this directly.
